failure_mode_downstream.value: If this roll-up is wrong, wave 2 fuses members into the wrong family buckets and STILL RETURNS A FULL MATRIX -- the fusion cannot signal a mis-bucketed member. It is DISTINGUISHABLE from genuine low affinity by exactly one check, and only if that check is run: the PARENT CENSUS. Genuine low affinity leaves the parent set intact (19 families, all populated); a wrong roll-up shows a family set smaller than the store's own node count, with members silently reassigned or dropped. THIS IS NOT HYPOTHETICAL: the floor this face carries says 13 parents and the store says 19, so a wave-2 run against the floor would exhibit exactly that signature. No fused value is asserted here.
